does: Builds StatusRemovedEntry (type 10) entries from the system's list of removal requests (+0x70, 0x58 bytes each), and for a removal that carries condition rolls sends saving-throw entries for them first.

evidence.says: esv::Status::SendCombatLogEntryRemoved appends to the array at +0x70 that this pass walks; calls SendSavingThrowEntriesForHitDesc when the request's roll count is above 0
Hold Person ended by a saving throw: SendCombatLogEntryRemoved once, SendSavingThrowEntriesForHitDesc once, one StatusRemoved entry handed to the protocol from inside this function
EoCServer.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
